annotation_author: Codex assistant, manual visual interpretation of fixed-map Sentinel-2 RGB; not field verified
annotation_method: Select compact interiors before fitting any classifier; inspect source context and nearest-neighbour enlarged pixel chips. No SCL class or classifier prediction is used as a land-cover label.
coordinate_convention: zero-based [x0,y0,x1,y1], upper bounds exclusive; rows increase southward

class_definitions.0: Closed-canopy forest interiors; exclude clearings, fields, river corridors and uncertain edges.
class_definitions.1: Continuous built-up impervious urban fabric: roofs, paved streets/courtyards and industrial structures. Exclude substantial vegetation, fields, water and uncertain edges.
class_definitions.255: Unlabelled or uncertain; no reference claim.

limitations: Visual labels at 10 m are approximate; subpixel mixing and small trees/shadows remain possible.
Training forest comes from Białowieża and urban from Kraków; class, geography and acquisition conditions are confounded.
The Tychy test references emphasize clear forest and impervious/industrial interiors; they are sparse and not a representative citywide survey.
